plain_english: This is the best petroleum-inventory rule found in a broad search, not a final confirmed trading rule. It beat buy-and-hold on Sharpe in the OOS window, but it was selected from 5123 valid combinations and has not passed a fresh holdout final exam.
technical_note: Tournament-OOS only (2017-08-31 to 2025-09-30). Winner bootstrap p=0.099; CP1=conditionally_durable; rolling-correlation=moderately_stable; Granger fwd=[6, 7, 8], reverse=none.
